'''Kan Nakkar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Yevetha]] of a low-ranking caste, who served his people as a [[Scout/Legends|scout]]. During his career, Nakkar was tasked with discovering more about the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] beyond the Yevethan [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[N'zoth]], and he was dispatched to investigate the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[J't'p'tan]], a duty that Nakkar loathed.
